figurative_meaning_en: Seeking trivial help at the last moment
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় ক্ষতির পর সে খড়কুটো ধরে বাঁচার চেষ্টা করছে।
পরীক্ষার আগের রাতে সে খড়কুটো ধরে বাঁচার মতো নোট পড়ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After the business loss, he is clutching at straws to survive.
On the night before the exam, she is clutching at straws by cramming notes.
history: This idiom likely originates from agrarian imagery where a drowning person might grasp at floating straw in desperation, reflecting rural Bengali life.
note: Reflects themes of futility in desperate situations, common in Bengali folklore.
